THE_PRE_REGISTERED_INTERPRETATION_APPLIE.what_it_establishes: An UPPER BOUND. A derivable, ~50-percent-of-support structural restriction, present with certainty in every treatment record (INTEG-D: 130816 of 130816 discriminants square, 0 non-square), produces a z-CDF displacement no larger than this instrument's detection floor at n = 130816.
THE_PRE_REGISTERED_INTERPRETATION_APPLIE.direction_it_cuts: Uncomfortable rather than reassuring: it measures the BLINDNESS OF THE PROJECTION, and it bounds what a not-reject of the treatment against a uniform null can ever mean, because a statistic that cannot see a proven structural difference cannot certify the absence of structure.
THE_PRE_REGISTERED_INTERPRETATION_APPLIE.the_permitted_statement: The support restriction produced no displacement this instrument could detect at this n, and the detection floor is 0.006373414579727891 in D units at n = 130816; the ARM 3 diagnostic ran and measured that a 1 percent ENC-A contamination is the smallest point on the frozen grid whose displacement exceeds that floor, while 0.5 percent does not.
THE_PRE_REGISTERED_INTERPRETATION_APPLIE.asymmetry_declared_by_the_contract: DETECTED would be a positive finding about the comparator. NOT-DETECTED is a bound on an instrument, never a finding about the object.

certificate.verification_rule: For every integer in every arm, code that does not call factorint again asserts every returned base prime under sympy.isprime, every exponent >= 1, and prod(q**e) == N exactly as Python integers. LPF = max(bases), LPF(1) := 1.

INTEG_G_independent_reverification.rule: deterministic 1-in-1000 subsample (sequential_index mod 1000 == 0) of EVERY arm re-factored by an INDEPENDENT trial-division + Pollard-rho routine that does not import or call sympy's factorization path

independent_reverification_of_the_decisi.why: The KS statistics are the load-bearing numbers of both arms, and the contract's certificate rule covers factorization, not the statistic. This check is additional to the contract, not a substitute for anything in it.
independent_reverification_of_the_decisi.method: A second, separate implementation (ks_verify.py) evaluating the ECDFs by bisect on the pooled distinct support, sharing no code with the driver's two-pointer merge.
independent_reverification_of_the_decisi.tie_handling_note: Both implementations evaluate the supremum ONLY at distinct pooled z values using counts <= t, i.e. at the right-continuous ECDF steps, never at a mid-tie point. This matters because z = ln(N)/ln(LPF(N)) has a large atom at z = 1 (measured mass 0.0481 in the treatment and 0.0474 in the enlarged null); a supremum evaluated inside that tie would report a spurious statistic of the order of the atom mass itself.
independent_reverification_of_the_decisi.internal_consistency: D_TU (ARM 2), D(m1) (DR-A1b) and D_0 (DR-A1c) are the same quantity computed by three separate code paths and agree exactly at 0.0052745841487280565.
